title: Coach PMs one to one
summary: Coaching helps PMs apply new skills on their real work. Ask good questions, agree goals and follow up, rather than giving all the answers.

beginner: Agree a goal with each PM you coach.
Meet regularly, such as every two weeks.
Ask questions that help them think, before giving advice.
Agree one action after each session.
Follow up on the action next time.
intermediate: Use real work as the material for coaching.
Track progress against the skills framework.
experienced: Coach PM leaders to coach their own teams.
Build a coaching culture, not a dependence on you.
Match PMs with mentors outside their reporting line.

toolExamples.notion: Keep private coaching notes and actions.
toolExamples.google-docs: Share a simple goals and actions log with each PM.

pitfalls: Coaching only when things go wrong
